title: 1997 Topps #204 Prospects Aaron Boone Gabe Alvarez RC Kevin Orie Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
1997 Topps #204 Prospects: Aaron Boone (Reds), Gabe Alvarez (Padres, rookie card) and Kevin Orie (Cubs). Early Aaron Boone card - later the 2003 ALCS hero and Yankees manager.

Ships in an eBay Standard Envelope.
